planet.en: People have started talking about a new nuclear age, a nuclear renaissance , where nuclear energy is treated not as "the answer" to how we power the planet, but as "part of the answer".
planet.zh: 人们开始谈论一个新的核能时代、一场核能复兴，核能不再被视为解决地球供电问题的“唯一答案”，而是“答案的一部分”。

plug.en: And, one more thing. Even once a data centre is built and ready to be turned on, you don't just plug it into the grid .
plug.zh: 而且，还有一件事。即便数据中心建好并准备通电，你也不能直接插到电网上。

plague.en: And small modular reactors , which I mentioned a few minutes ago, are another way to fight the issues that have plagued the construction of these large nuclear power plants.
plague.zh: 而我几分钟前提到的小型模块化反应堆，则是解决困扰这些大型核电站建设难题的另一种途径。
